questions.answer: the local supermarket is small so there aren't many options for cheap food.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: even if Iceland is very expensive the coffee is cheaper than in Denmark. Transportation in the country is expensive. Almost 90 euros one-way trip from Reykjavik to Husavik.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Husavik is a small village, there isn't much to do. However there is a public swimming pool with good prices, one can always go hiking and students organize many activities as well.

questions.answer: To experience Iceland and travel around.

questions.answer: It is mostly for people who love marine mammals.
